dct_description_sm: Located in the heart of Ottawa’s Glebe neighbourhood, St. Matthew’s Anglican Church welcomes the surrounding residential community with open arms.  Situated within the boundaries of land designated for religious buildings that stretch from the Queensway to the Rideau Canal, the church is among the numerous shops, cafes, and schools that give the Glebe its wholesome atmosphere. This is the Integrated Project Dossier compiled by a group of undergrad students of the Architectural Conservation and Sustainability Program (Engineers and architects) at Carleton University for the CIVE3207 (ARCN4100) Historic Site Recording and Assessment course in 2016.
dct_title_s: St. Matthew’s Anglican Church - Integrated Project Dossier (2016)
